opportunities.name: Propose hotel to colleague with currency-converted price
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in {city} for {check_in}–{check_out}, pick a hotel, convert its EUR total price into {target_currency} on xe.com, and draft an email to {recipient} proposing the hotel.
steps: On booking.com, click 'Enter destination', select all and type {city}
Open the date picker, go to the right month with 'Next month' if needed, click {check_in} and {check_out}
Click Search
Pick a hotel from the results (e.g. a well-rated one) and note its name and EUR total for the stay
On xe.com Currency Converter (EUR as the source currency), select the amount field and type the EUR price
Open the target-currency dropdown, search {target_currency} and select it, then read the converted amount
In mail, open New message, set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Hotel for {city}, {check_in}-{check_out}'
Set Body = 'Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel}, {price} EUR (about {converted} {target_currency}). OK to book?'
Send (the recording clicked Discard)

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17–Nov 20 2026; Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South 818 EUR → 915.34 USD; maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1–Dec 4 2026; BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti 264 EUR → 46,794 JPY; kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12–Jan 15 2027 (after an abandoned Zurich search at ~793s); Jan Luyken Amsterdam 577 EUR → 487.44 GBP; aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City heads-up email (weather + strike news)
opportunities.description: Get the 10-day forecast for {city} on weather.com, search BBC for '{city} strike' news, and draft a heads-up email to {recipient} with the forecast for {day} and the top headline.
steps: On weather.com, click the location button and open 'Search for a location'
Type {city} and pick the matching suggestion
Click the '10 Day' tab and read the high/low and conditions for {day}
On bbc.com, open the menu or 'Search BBC', select the search box and type '{city} strike', then press Enter
Open the top result and note its headline and date
In mail, open New message, set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Set Body = 'Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}°/{low}°, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send (the recording clicked Discard)

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday; 58°/44° Partly Cloudy; 'Students strike across Germany…'; raj@example.com
Madrid, Monday; 64°/50° Partly Cloudy; 'Villa eye Endrick loan deal…'; sofia@example.com
London, Thursday; 70°/56° Cloudy; 'School support staff strike over pay'; tom@example.com

opportunities.name: Traveler visa + destination holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' on Wikipedia for {destination}, find {destination}'s public holidays in {month} on timeanddate.com, and save a summary note.
steps: On Wikipedia, select the search box and type 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens', then press Enter
Use Ctrl+F to find {destination} in the table and note the visa requirement and allowed stay
On timeanddate.com, dismiss the privacy dialog (Deny all), go to Holidays, then search for or click {destination}
Open the holiday list for the year and note the holidays in {month}
In Notes, click 'New note' and type '{nationality} traveler to {destination}: {visa_info}, allowed stay {stay}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}'
Press Enter to save

instances.values: Brazilian → Canada; visa required (eTA possible); November holidays
Nigerian → United Kingdom; visa required; May holidays
